repo.frames.py:
"""Windows over the visits feed."""
import itertools


def summarize_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` visits from the feed and return (peak minutes, list of minutes).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    window = itertools.islice(feed, size)
    peak = max(x.minutes for x in window)
    values = [x.minutes for x in window]
    return peak, values


def largest_minutes(visits):
    """Return the largest minutes, or None when there are no visits."""
    values = [x.minutes for x in visits]
    return max(values) if values else None


def describe_visit(visit):
    """Return a one-line description of a visit."""
    return "%s: %s" % (visit.page, visit.minutes)

from visits import feed_visits, ROWS
from frames import summarize_window


def test_values():
    peak, values = summarize_window(feed_visits(), 3)
    assert values == [v for _, v in ROWS[:3]]


def test_reads_only_the_window():
    feed = feed_visits()
    summarize_window(feed, 2)
    assert next(feed).minutes == ROWS[2][1]
